'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Paragano DS On The Hunt''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Paragano]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[On The Hunt]]
* '''Username:''' GunganStyle
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
